name: gi-corporate-tax
description: Prepare a corporate tax working paper for accounting periods wholly after 1 July 2024, checked in 2026. This draft covers income categories, expense adjustments, capital allowances, trade losses, cessation stock valuation, accounting periods, payments and filing controls. It includes UK treaty permanent-establishment and profit-attribution rules; Pillar Two, specialised exemptions and other treaty corridors remain outside the completed draft scope. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
